data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), after an enemy unit finishes a [fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back).

**Target:** An **unengaged** **ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY** unit of yours up to 6" from that enemy unit.

**Effect:** The unit declares a charge. As its **charge targets**, it can pick only enemy units within its **maximum distance** that [fell back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) this phase.

detail.trigger: an enemy unit ends a fall-back move

effects.chargeTargetsLimitedTo: enemy units that fell back in this phase, inside maximum charge distance
